name: Port Clinton Manufacturing Co
old_description: More than making individual parts, PCM specializes in mating parts together through various methods including brazing and mechanical fits producing a precision assembly for additional machining or ready for assembly.
about:
Port Clinton Manufacturing Co. has operated from Port Clinton, Ohio, since its founding in 1929. The company remains a closely held family corporation, locally owned and operated across nearly a century of continuous service.

The 68,000-square-foot facility houses 25 automatic screw machines capable of work through 3.5 inches, supplemented by CNC lathes and CNC multi-spindle chuckers handling blanks up to 12 inches in diameter. A broaching department runs 12 machines with a 54-inch stroke and 15-ton capacity, while grinding operations cover ID, OD, centerless, double-disk, and Blanchard processes. Secondary machining includes thread rolling, knurling, drilling, tapping, cross drilling, deep-hole drilling, honing, milling, tumbling, bead blasting, and a range of cutoff and forming operations. Heat treating and coating are managed through a qualified external network. The company also performs ultrasonic cleaning and Millipore particle-count testing. Precision assemblies — joined by brazing or mechanical fits — are produced in-house, either as finished units or as in-process components brought to final tolerance after assembly.

Primary markets include railroad, oil and gas, mining, emergency power generation, agricultural and construction equipment, mine safety devices, heavy-truck transmissions, and brake systems. As a tier 1 supplier to major engine manufacturers, the shop supports PPAP requirements and has maintained relationships with several Fortune 500 customers for more than 50 years.

The business emphasizes integrity, fair dealing, and continuous improvement to reduce cost while preserving quality. Its quality program targets zero defects, backed by CMM, optical comparator, surface-finish, Magnaflux, and Rockwell hardness inspection, and has earned a Dun & Bradstreet AAA rating.
